_comment: Settled design decisions. check_locks.py fails when furnish.js or a built model breaks one; Edit AI refuses to save an edit that breaks a lock unless the request names it (one of the lock's 'names'; it then saves and marks the lock 'suspended' with the request so pushes go on); the pre-push hook (.githooks) refuses a push. To change a lock on purpose: change the design AND the numbers here in the same commit, with the new decided_by/date.
